connector.name: adrkit decision memory
connector.registryDescription: Deterministic, offline, read-only ADR decision memory for coding agents. No model or network calls.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.adrkit, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: ADRKIT_MCP_CWD
env.description: Repository root; must contain a readable .git entry. Defaults to the process working directory.

env.name: ADRKIT_MCP_DIR
env.description: ADR directory, resolved against the root and required to stay contained within it. Defaults to docs/adr.
